findings.message: Stream 1 is coded as PCM (format tag 0x0001), which has no parser here; its media objects are not analyzed.
The Timecode Index Parameters Object lists index type 1, which section 4.11 says is not a valid value for a timecode index.
The Media Object Index Object's index specifiers differ from those of the Media Object Index Parameters Object in the header, which they must match exactly (section 4.10).
The Timecode Index Object's index specifiers differ from those of the Timecode Index Parameters Object in the header, which they must match exactly (section 4.11).
